core_obligations: With standard spin/Spin^r definitions, Schur/Clebsch–Gordan theory, the exterior Clifford model and homogeneous-connection formulas supplied as background, the complete author classification still has to coordinate the isotropy lifts, twisted invariant tensors and the auxiliary connections across the projective realizations. In the Cayley-plane case this requires the concrete non-diagonal Spin(9) root actions lifted to the chiral Spin(16) modules, the multiplicity-four component in the triple spin tensor, and the lowering-operator/dual-musical construction of invariant spinors. The same exterior model supplies the degree-component obstruction to higher-dimensional invariant generalized Killing spinors and the explicit odd-quaternionic invariant tensor with its geometric interpretation. This coordinated construction is retained as one H2 summary-theorem unit; isolated Schur arguments, weight matches, standard tensor decompositions and final parallelism applications are not independent H3 counts. Reported computer algebra is preserved at author granularity and not independently rerun.
proof_roadmap: Use the authors own summary theorem/Table1 as one principal classification unit. Retain every supplied projective-case construction and geometric consequence, preserving parity conditions and blank/uncomputed entries.
